dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So many people lining up to enter the harbor, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: Well, pal, there are always way too many people waiting to enter the harbor, and the queue times have always been a little... Well, sometimes it's slow, and sometimes it's very slow.

dialogues.speaker: Yrjo
dialogues.text: And the conveyor belt's broken, too. I guess when it rains, it pours, and when it pours, the roof starts leaking buckets...
